WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT
    i.subject_id,
    i.hadm_id,
    i.stay_id,
    i.intime,
    i.outtime,
    p.anchor_age,
    p.gender
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.icustays` i
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
      ON i.subject_id = p.subject_id
  WHERE
    p.gender = 'M'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 55 AND 65
),
hfnc_flag AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.stay_id,
    TRUE AS hfnc
  FROM
    cohort c
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.procedureevents` pe
      ON c.stay_id = pe.stay_id
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.d_items` di
      ON pe.itemid = di.itemid
  WHERE
    LOWER(di.label) LIKE '%high flow nasal cannula%'
    AND pe.starttime BETWEEN c.intime
                       AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(c.intime, INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
),
stay_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    c.stay_id,
    IF(h.hfnc IS TRUE, 'HFNC', 'Control') AS group_label,
    -- Instability Score measurements
    ARRAY_AGG(ce_inst.valuenum) AS inst_scores,
    -- Tachycardia: HR > 100 bpm
    SUM(CASE WHEN ce_hr.valuenum > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
      / NULLIF(COUNT(ce_hr.valuenum), 0) AS tachy_burden,
    -- Hypotension: MAP < 65 mmHg
    SUM(CASE WHEN ce_map.valuenum < 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
      / NULLIF(COUNT(ce_map.valuenum), 0) AS hypo_burden,
    -- ICU LOS
    i.los,
    -- Mortality flag
    adm.hospital_expire_flag AS died_in_hosp
  FROM
    cohort c
    LEFT JOIN hfnc_flag h
      ON c.stay_id = h.stay_id
    LEFT JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.icustays` i
      ON c.stay_id = i.stay_id
    LEFT JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` adm
      ON c.hadm_id = adm.hadm_id
    -- Instability score
    LEFT JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.chartevents` ce_inst
      ON c.stay_id = ce_inst.stay_id
    LEFT JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.d_items` di_inst
      ON ce_inst.itemid = di_inst.itemid
    -- Heart rate
    LEFT JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.chartevents` ce_hr
      ON c.stay_id = ce_hr.stay_id
    LEFT JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.d_items` di_hr
      ON ce_hr.itemid = di_hr.itemid
    -- MAP
    LEFT JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.chartevents` ce_map
      ON c.stay_id = ce_map.stay_id
    LEFT JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.d_items` di_map
      ON ce_map.itemid = di_map.itemid
  WHERE
    -- Restrict each join to the appropriate label
    (di_inst.label ILIKE '%instability score%' 
     AND ce_inst.charttime BETWEEN c.intime AND c.outtime)
    AND (di_hr.label ILIKE '%heart rate%' 
     AND ce_hr.charttime BETWEEN c.intime AND c.outtime)
    AND (di_map.label ILIKE '%mean arterial pressure%' 
     AND ce_map.charttime BETWEEN c.intime AND c.outtime)
  GROUP BY
    c.stay_id,
    group_label,
    i.los,
    adm.hospital_expire_flag
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    group_label,
    -- Instability score percentiles
    PERCENTILE_CONT(inst_scores, 0.25) OVER (PARTITION BY group_label) AS inst_p25,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(inst_scores, 0.50) OVER (PARTITION BY group_label) AS inst_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(inst_scores, 0.75) OVER (PARTITION BY group_label) AS inst_p75,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(inst_scores, 0.95) OVER (PARTITION BY group_label) AS inst_p95,
    -- Tachy and hypo burdens: report median
    PERCENTILE_CONT(ARRAY_AGG(tachy_burden) OVER (PARTITION BY group_label), 0.50) AS tachy_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(ARRAY_AGG(hypo_burden) OVER (PARTITION BY group_label), 0.50) AS hypo_median,
    -- LOS median
    PERCENTILE_CONT(ARRAY_AGG(los) OVER (PARTITION BY group_label), 0.50) AS los_median,
    -- Mortality rate
    SUM(CASE WHEN died_in_hosp = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
      * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS mortality_rate
  FROM
    stay_metrics
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  group_label,
  inst_p25,
  inst_median,
  inst_p75,
  inst_p95,
  tachy_median   AS tachycardia_burden_median,
  hypo_median    AS hypotension_burden_median,
  los_median     AS icu_los_median,
  mortality_rate
FROM
  agg
ORDER BY
  group_label;
